description: One place the agent may send a Telegram message. A Telegram bot cannot start a conversation, so every destination here is a chat that already exists: a group or channel the bot has been added to, or a person who has pressed Start on it.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: What the accountant will call this when asking the agent to send something - for example 'Finance Team'.

fields.label: Chat ID
fields.description: The numeric chat id Telegram gives you. Group ids are negative. See the setup guide for how to find it - it is not a phone number and cannot be guessed.

fields.label: Default
fields.description: Where a Telegram message goes when the accountant does not name a destination.

name: Agent Telegram Destination
